'''Xellar''' was a company that produced entertainment systems that were fitted in [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valles Santhe]] had a Xellar entertainment system fitted in her personal [[A-1 Deluxe Floater/Legends|A-1 Deluxe Floater]].
